conic-input.limits: Lightweight checks reverify both moment/Schur ranks and coordinate normal forms; included programs provide the independent matching reconstruction and transvectant identification.
conic-input.role: Matrices, moments, Schur squares and invariant cubic identities

factory.limits: Independent uniform Z inputs and ideal stabilizer operations; only specified separate-distillation menu. Deterministic Python standard library exact arithmetic.
factory.role: Exact native/primitive/synthesis enumerators and interval inequalities

magic-comparison.limits: Full source enumeration through p=19; p13 spectrum sampled, new p11/p13 X-distances only upper bounds. Distance search has one implementation and a domain-count check. Full p19 search about five minutes on 24 cores.
magic-comparison.role: Conic source, other spectra, distance search and exact entropy comparisons

rank-census.limits: p=11: trusted exhaustive execution, 2593742460 projective representatives, about 82 seconds on 24 cores; p=7 independently reproduced. No new full census asserted.
rank-census.role: Exact p=7/11 projective Hessian counts, minimum loci and Waring bound

shadow.limits: Finite-field computations, not a classification of all full-gate lifts. Replay regenerates serialized intermediates in sequence in an isolated copy and checks the normalized shadow; about 30 seconds. Exact identities are distinguished from sampled probes.
shadow.role: A5 decomposition, explicit Hankel identity, pencil counts and scoped lift tests

shadow-normalization.limits: Reads three pinned committed serialized intermediates and reuses finite-field substitution utilities; independently checks all 1320 restrictions, 60 preserve V5, all determinant1, q determinant-1. Does not rederive the geometric representation or rerun shadow rank censuses. Deterministic standard-library computation, under one second.
shadow-normalization.role: Exact actual/projective scalar, involutory exchange, explicit coefficient and embedding certificate, exhaustive geometric restriction test
